description_en: Queries the details of a resource export task
description_zh: 查询资源导出任务详情
name: GetResourceExportTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource export task
parameters.name: export_task_id

createTime.description_en: The time when the task was created
createTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

exportTaskId.description_en: The ID of the resource export task

exportToModule.description_en: Saves the exported template as a module. If this parameter is not set, the template is automatically saved in the registry
exportToModule.description_zh: 将导出后的模板保存为Module。 如果未设置，那么将自动保存在Registry中

source.description_en:
The module type in which the exported template is saved. Valid values:

OSS: OSS
Registry: Terraform Registry
source.description_zh:
导出后的模板保存的Module类型。可选值：

OSS ：OSS
Registry: Terraform Registry

sourcePath.description_en:
The path where the template content is saved.

If Source is set to Registry, the format is: "cloudregistry::iacservice//"

If Source is set to OSS, the format is: "oss::https://.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/xxx.zip"
sourcePath.description_zh:
保存模板内容的路径值

当 Source 为 Registry 时，格式为： "cloudregistry::iacservice//"

当 Source 为 OSS 时，格式为："oss::https://.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/xxx.zip"

statePath.description_en: The path of the state file that corresponds to the module
statePath.description_zh: Module 对应的State文件的路径值

includeRules.description_en: The values of the include rules for resource export
includeRules.description_zh: 一组资源导出时的包含规则的值

items.description_en: The values of the include rules for resource export
items.description_zh: 一组资源导出时的包含规则的值

key.description_en:
The name of the include rule for resource export. Valid values:

ResourceType: required. The resource type. Example: ALIYUN::VPC::VPC.
RegionId: required. The region to which the resource belongs. Only one region is supported. Example: ap-southeast-1.
\<ResourceType>:Id: the resource ID. Example: ALIYUN::VPC::VPC:Id.
ResourceGroupId: the resource group ID. Example: rg-1234.
ZoneId: the zone to which the resource belongs. Only one zone is supported. Example: ap-southeast-1a.

By default, the relationship between multiple filter conditions is AND. A resource is considered matched only if all filter conditions are met
key.description_zh:
资源导出时的包含规则名称。可选值如下：

ResourceType：必填，资源类型，例如：ALIYUN::VPC::VPC
RegionId：必填，资源所属Region，当前只支持一个Region，例如：cn-chengdu
\<ResourceType>:Id：资源ID,例如：ALIYUN::VPC::VPC:Id
ResourceGroupId：资源组ID，例如：rg-1234
ZoneId：资源所属Zone，目前只支持一个Zone，例如：cn-hangzhou-h

多个过滤条件之间默认是与的关系，即必须符合所有过滤条件，才视为匹配过滤条件

values.description_en: The values of the include rules for resource export
values.description_zh: 一组资源导出时的包含规则的值

items.description_en: The values of the include rules for resource export
items.description_zh: 一组资源导出时的包含规则的值

modules.description_en: The module configuration for the exported resources

items.description_en: The module configuration for the exported resources

source.description_en: The module type where the exported template is stored. Two formats are supported: CloudRegistry and OSS. If the ExportToModule parameter is specified, both formats are returned. Otherwise, only CloudRegistry is returned
source.description_zh: 导出后的模板所在的Module类型，目前有两种格式：CloudRegistry 和OSS。如果客户指定了参数 ExportToModule，那么这两种都将返回，否则只返回 CloudRegistry

sourcePath.description_en:
The download URL of the module where the exported template is stored.

If Source is set to CloudRegistry, the format is: "cloudregistry::iacservice//"

If Source is set to OSS, the format is: "oss::https://.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/xxx.zip"
sourcePath.description_zh:
导出后的模板所在的Module下的下载地址。

当 Source 为 CloudRegistry 时，格式为： "cloudregistry::iacservice//"


当 Source 为 OSS 时，格式为："oss::https://.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/xxx.zip"

version.description_en: The version of the module where the exported template is stored
version.description_zh: 导出后的模板所在的Module的版本

status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Available: the task is available and no job is running.
Running: a job is currently running
status.description_zh:
任务状态

Available：可用状态，没有任何job在运行
Running：运行状态，当前job正在运行

triggerStrategy.description_en:
The trigger strategy. Valid values:
Auto: triggered automatically when rules are modified or the trigger strategy is changed to Auto.
Manual: triggered manually.

Default value: Manual
triggerStrategy.description_zh:
触发策略，有效值：
Auto： 当修改规则或触发策略被改为Auto触发
Manual：手动触发

默认值为：Manual

variables.description_en: The list of variables. Parameters in the exported resources are set as variables
variables.description_zh: 变量列表，将资源导出后的参数设置为变量

items.description_en: The list of variables. Parameters in the exported resources are set as variables
items.description_zh: 变量列表，将资源导出后的参数设置为变量

properties.description_en: The list of properties of the Terraform resource that corresponds to the resource type
properties.description_zh: 资源类型对应的Terraform资源的属性列表

items.description_en: The property of the Terraform resource that corresponds to the resource type
items.description_zh: 资源类型对应的Terraform资源的属性
